objects.name: Detection technique coverage: linux-awk-privilege-escalation
objects.description: The following analytic detects the use of the AWK command with elevated privileges to execute system commands. It leverages Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) telemetry, specifically monitoring processes that include "sudo," "awk," and "BEGIN*system" in their command lines. This activity is significant because it indicates a potential privilege escalation attempt, where a user could gain root access by executing commands as the root user.
